structure.unit: Possession of Retail Marijuana and Retail Marijuana Products; Prohibited Practices Generally

law.catch_line: Possessing or consuming marijuana or marijuana products while operating a school bus; penalty
law.text: Any person who possesses or consumes marijuana or marijuana products while operating a school bus and transporting children is guilty of a Class 1 misdemeanor. For the purposes of this section, "school bus" has the same meaning as provided in § 46.2-100.
